items_flat.title_en: Meta Releases Muse Glimmer: 30B Open-Weight Agentic Model for Local Devices
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Glimmer：30B 開源權重本地代理模型
items_flat.summary_en: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Glimmer, an approximately 30-billion-parameter open-weight multimodal model optimized for always-on local agentic workflows. It is available under Apache 2.0, runs on a single consumer GPU after quantization, and was distilled from Muse Spark for tool use, multi-step tasks, coding and failure recovery.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta Superintelligence Labs 發布 Muse Glimmer，約 300 億參數開源權重多模態模型，專為持續本地代理工作流優化。採 Apache 2.0 授權，量化後可在單一消費級 GPU 運行，並從 Muse Spark 蒸餾而來，支援工具使用、多步驟任務、程式與失敗恢復。
items_flat.analysis_en: This renews Meta’s open-weight push into the on-device agent niche, prioritising privacy and offline capability against closed cloud models. Independent verification of claimed agentic benchmarks versus peers of similar size will determine real adoption impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉延續 Meta 開源權重策略，切入裝置端代理利基，強調隱私與離線能力以對抗封閉雲端模型。獨立驗證其代理基準與同尺寸模型的實際差距，將決定真正採用影響。
items_flat.quote: Today, we're introducing Muse Glimmer, the next model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, and open sourcing the model weights under a permissive Apache 2.0 license. Muse Glimmer is a 30-billion-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 Meta Superintelligence Labs 的下一個模型 Muse Glimmer，並以寬鬆的 Apache 2.0 授權開源模型權重。Muse Glimmer 是一個 300 億參數模型，專為持續本地代理工作流優化。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Expands Daybreak with GPT-5.6-Cyber for Approved Cyber Defenders
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 擴展 Daybreak 並推出 GPT-5.6-Cyber 供核准網路防禦者使用
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI expanded its Daybreak program into Blue and Red tiers and released GPT-5.6-Cyber, a specialised model based on GPT-5.6 Sol trained for advanced vulnerability research, exploit development and zero-day discovery. Access is restricted to approved defenders; the model raised advanced cybersecurity completion rates to 95% versus 1.5% for the base model.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 將 Daybreak 計畫擴展為 Blue 與 Red 兩級，並發布基於 GPT-5.6 Sol 的專用模型 GPT-5.6-Cyber，針對進階漏洞研究、漏洞開發與零日發現進行訓練。存取僅限核准防禦者；該模型將進階網路安全完成率提升至 95%，相較基礎模型僅 1.5%。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move acknowledges frontier models’ dual-use nature in cybersecurity and attempts to tip capability toward defenders under gated access. Whether restricted distribution meaningfully slows malicious use while enabling real defensive gains remains the key open question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉承認前沿模型在網路安全的雙用性質，並嘗試在門禁存取下將能力偏向防禦方。受限分發能否在真實防禦效益與減緩惡意使用之間取得平衡，仍是關鍵未解問題。
items_flat.quote: We’re expanding OpenAI Daybreak with two access tiers designed to give approved defenders the right capabilities for their work. ... GPT-5.6-Cyber completes 95.0% of these requests, compared with just 1.5% for GPT-5.6 Sol.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正以兩個存取層級擴展 OpenAI Daybreak，旨在為核准防禦者提供適合其工作的能力。……GPT-5.6-Cyber 完成 95.0% 的這些請求，相較 GPT-5.6 Sol 僅 1.5%。

items_flat.title_en: Unreleased Claude Improves Lower Bound on Riemann Zeta Zeros Satisfying the Hypothesis to 67.2%
items_flat.title_zh: 未公開 Claude 將黎曼ζ函數滿足假設的零點下界提升至 67.2%
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic reported that an unreleased research version of Claude, tasked with attempting the Riemann hypothesis, did not solve it but improved a related longstanding lower bound: the fraction of zeros of the Riemann zeta function known to lie on the critical line rose from 41.6% to 67.2%. The result was validated by Anthropic mathematicians, examined by external experts, and accompanied by a Lean formalisation.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 報告指出，一個未公開的 Claude 研究版本在挑戰黎曼假設時未能解決，但改善了相關長期下界：已知位於臨界線上的黎曼ζ函數零點比例從 41.6% 提升至 67.2%。結果經 Anthropic 數學家驗證、外部專家審閱，並附有 Lean 形式化證明。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a concrete demonstration of frontier models contributing non-trivial, expert-validated progress on a classic open problem in pure mathematics. It does not resolve the Riemann hypothesis itself and leaves open how much of the advance is novel insight versus recombination of prior results.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是前沿模型在純數學經典開放問題上貢獻非平凡、經專家驗證進展的具體示範。它並未解決黎曼假設本身，且仍不確定進展中有多少是新見解、多少是既有結果的重組。
items_flat.quote: We asked an unreleased research version of Claude to take a stab at the Riemann hypothesis. It didn’t solve it, but it did make strides on a related problem: it increased the lower bound for the fraction of zeros of the Riemann zeta function that satisfy the hypothesis from 41.6% to 67.2%.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們要求一個未公開的 Claude 研究版本嘗試黎曼假設。它沒有解決，但在相關問題上取得進展：將滿足假設的黎曼ζ函數零點比例下界從 41.6% 提升至 67.2%。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA Partners with Major Funds to Mobilize Over $500B for AI Compute Infrastructure
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 與大型基金合作動員逾 5000 億美元 AI 算力基礎設施融資
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish independent financing platforms aimed at mobilizing more than $500 billion of third-party capital for AI compute and AI-factory infrastructure. The platforms treat accelerated compute as an investable asset class for customers across frontier labs, enterprises and AI clouds.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 宣布與 Apollo、BlackRock、Blackstone、Brookfield、Goldman Sachs 及 KKR 合作，建立獨立融資平台，目標動員逾 5000 億美元第三方資本用於 AI 算力與 AI 工廠基礎設施。這些平台將加速算力視為可投資資產類別，服務前沿實驗室、企業與 AI 雲端客戶。
items_flat.analysis_en: The scale signals that capital markets now view accelerated compute as core infrastructure rather than pure technology spend. Execution risk remains high given the size of commitments and the need to match long-duration capital with rapidly evolving hardware cycles.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此規模顯示資本市場已將加速算力視為核心基礎設施而非純技術支出。鑑於承諾金額龐大，以及需將長期資本與快速演進的硬體週期匹配，執行風險仍高。
items_flat.quote: We began by building chips; today, we are helping create a new class of productive, investable infrastructure: AI factories. In AI, compute is revenue.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們從製造晶片開始；今天，我們正協助創造一類新的生產性、可投資基礎設施：AI 工廠。在 AI 中，算力就是營收。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Introduces Premium Seats for ChatGPT Business
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 為 ChatGPT Business 推出 Premium 席位
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced Premium seats for ChatGPT Business, offering 5× the usage of Standard seats, removal of the five-hour usage limit, and the ability to mix seat types within the same workspace. Pricing is $125 per user per month (or $100 annually); a limited-time credit promotion is available for early adopters.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布為 ChatGPT Business 推出 Premium 席位，提供標準席位 5 倍使用量、取消五小時使用限制，並可在同一工作區混用席位類型。價格為每月每用戶 125 美元（年付 100 美元）；早期採用者可享限時點數優惠。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a straightforward capacity upsell for heavier Business users rather than a capability leap. It addresses customer feedback on rate limits but does not alter the underlying model access or introduce new agentic features.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是針對重度 Business 用戶的直接容量升級，而非能力躍進。它回應了客戶對速率限制的回饋，但未改變底層模型存取或引入新代理功能。
items_flat.quote: That’s why we’re introducing Premium seats for ChatGPT Business. Premium gives your most active teammates 5x more usage than Standard seats and removes the five-hour usage limit.
items_flat.quote_zh: 因此我們為 ChatGPT Business 推出 Premium 席位。Premium 為最活躍的團隊成員提供標準席位 5 倍使用量，並取消五小時使用限制。
